item.title: Coupled H+/Na+ Interlayer Regulation and Porous Nanoflower Architecture Enable Superior Zinc-Ion Storage in Hydrogen Sodium Vanadate Cathodes
item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a rapid one-step hydrothermal synthesis of H+/Na+ cointercalated hydrogen sodium vanadate with a porous nanoflower architecture. Na+ pillars stabilize the layered framework while H+ enables local charge compensation, lowering Zn2+ diffusion barriers. This dual-ion strategy yields superior zinc-ion storage in both coin and flexible pouch cells, offering a practical route to high-performance aqueous battery cathodes.
🏷 zinc-ion battery · vanadate cathode · H+/Na+ cointercalation · nanoflower · aqueous electrolyte

item.title: Sequential anion chemistry enables dynamic interphase regulation in high-voltage LiCoO 2
item.description:

Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a diluent-mediated sequential solvation strategy that selectively redistributes two anions around Li⁺, enabling sequential interfacial chemistry: DFOB⁻ builds the initial CEI, while BF₄⁻ dynamically repairs defects and quenches reactive oxygen. This stabilizes high-voltage LiCoO₂, achieving 500 cycles at 4.5 V (73.5% retention) and 265.8 Wh/kg pouch cells with excellent −20°C performance, providing mechanistic insight into solvation-driven anion chemistry.
